"""
The ODE system of the model `Koenig_demo_v15`.

Written by sbmlode 0.3.3, SBML L3V1.

Units of the model:

    time       s
    substance  mole
    extent     mole
    volume     m^3
    area       m^2
    length     m

States x:

       id    name  unit
    1  c__A  A     mole/m^3
    2  c__B  B     mole/m^3
    3  c__C  C     mole/m^3
    4  e__A  A     mole/m^3
    5  e__B  B     mole/m^3
    6  e__C  C     mole/m^3

`initial_values(p)` returns the initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0,
`f!(dx, x, p, t)` the rates of change of the states and `f_y(x, p, t)` the assigned
values y, the rules and the reaction rates.
"""
module Koenig_demo_v15

export XIDS, PIDS, YIDS, NAMES, UNITS, P0, EVENTS, initial_values, f!, f_y

# the ids of the states x, the constants p and the assigned values y
const XIDS = [
    "c__A",  # A [mole/m^3]
    "c__B",  # B [mole/m^3]
    "c__C",  # C [mole/m^3]
    "e__A",  # A [mole/m^3]
    "e__B",  # B [mole/m^3]
    "e__C",  # C [mole/m^3]
]
const PIDS = [
    "e",  # external compartment [m^3]
    "c",  # cell compartment [m^3]
    "m",  # plasma membrane [m^2]
    "scale_f",  # metabolic scaling factor [-]
    "Vmax_bA",  # [mol/s]
    "Km_A",  # [mmol/l]
    "Vmax_bB",  # [mol/s]
    "Km_B",  # [mmol/l]
    "Vmax_bC",  # [mol/s]
    "Km_C",  # [mmol/l]
    "Vmax_v1",  # [mol/s]
    "Keq_v1",  # [-]
    "Vmax_v2",  # [mol/s]
    "Vmax_v3",  # [mol/s]
    "Vmax_v4",  # [mol/s]
    "Keq_v4",  # [-]
]
const YIDS = [
    "bA",  # bA (A import) [mole/s]
    "bB",  # bB (B export) [mole/s]
    "bC",  # bC (C export) [mole/s]
    "v1",  # v1 (A -> B) [mole/s]
    "v2",  # v2 (A -> C) [mole/s]
    "v3",  # v3 (C -> A) [mole/s]
    "v4",  # v4 (C -> B) [mole/s]
]

# the names and the units of the ids
const NAMES = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "c__A" => "A",
    "c__B" => "B",
    "c__C" => "C",
    "e__A" => "A",
    "e__B" => "B",
    "e__C" => "C",
    "e" => "external compartment",
    "c" => "cell compartment",
    "m" => "plasma membrane",
    "scale_f" => "metabolic scaling factor",
    "Vmax_bA" => nothing,
    "Km_A" => nothing,
    "Vmax_bB" => nothing,
    "Km_B" => nothing,
    "Vmax_bC" => nothing,
    "Km_C" => nothing,
    "Vmax_v1" => nothing,
    "Keq_v1" => nothing,
    "Vmax_v2" => nothing,
    "Vmax_v3" => nothing,
    "Vmax_v4" => nothing,
    "Keq_v4" => nothing,
    "bA" => "bA (A import)",
    "bB" => "bB (B export)",
    "bC" => "bC (C export)",
    "v1" => "v1 (A -> B)",
    "v2" => "v2 (A -> C)",
    "v3" => "v3 (C -> A)",
    "v4" => "v4 (C -> B)",
)
const UNITS = Dict{String, Union{Nothing, String}}(
    "c__A" => "mole/m^3",
    "c__B" => "mole/m^3",
    "c__C" => "mole/m^3",
    "e__A" => "mole/m^3",
    "e__B" => "mole/m^3",
    "e__C" => "mole/m^3",
    "e" => "m^3",
    "c" => "m^3",
    "m" => "m^2",
    "scale_f" => "-",
    "Vmax_bA" => "mol/s",
    "Km_A" => "mmol/l",
    "Vmax_bB" => "mol/s",
    "Km_B" => "mmol/l",
    "Vmax_bC" => "mol/s",
    "Km_C" => "mmol/l",
    "Vmax_v1" => "mol/s",
    "Keq_v1" => "-",
    "Vmax_v2" => "mol/s",
    "Vmax_v3" => "mol/s",
    "Vmax_v4" => "mol/s",
    "Keq_v4" => "-",
    "bA" => "mole/s",
    "bB" => "mole/s",
    "bC" => "mole/s",
    "v1" => "mole/s",
    "v2" => "mole/s",
    "v3" => "mole/s",
    "v4" => "mole/s",
)

# the default values of the constants, `NaN` for one without a value, e.g. one which an
# initial assignment sets and `initial_values` computes
const P0 = [
    1.0e-6,  # e
    1.0e-6,  # c
    1.0,  # m
    1.0e-6,  # scale_f
    5.0,  # Vmax_bA
    1.0,  # Km_A
    2.0,  # Vmax_bB
    0.5,  # Km_B
    2.0,  # Vmax_bC
    3.0,  # Km_C
    1.0,  # Vmax_v1
    10.0,  # Keq_v1
    0.5,  # Vmax_v2
    0.5,  # Vmax_v3
    0.5,  # Vmax_v4
    2.0,  # Keq_v4
]

"""
    initial_values(p=P0)

The initial states x0 and the constants p at t = 0.

The initial values, initial assignments and the rules they need are evaluated in the
order of their dependencies.

Every constant keeps the value passed.

Returns the initial states x0 and the constants p, a new vector.
"""
function initial_values(p::AbstractVector{<:Real}=P0)
    p = collect(Float64, p)
    # initial values
    c__A = 0.0  # A [mole/m^3]
    c__B = 0.0  # B [mole/m^3]
    c__C = 0.0  # C [mole/m^3]
    e__A = 0.0  # A [mole/m^3]
    e__B = 0.0  # B [mole/m^3]
    e__C = 0.0  # C [mole/m^3]
    x0 = Float64[c__A, c__B, c__C, e__A, e__B, e__C]
    return x0, p
end

"""
    f!(dx, x, p, t)

The rates of change dx/dt of the states x at the time t, written into dx.
"""
function f!(dx, x, p, t)
    # states
    c__A = x[1]  # A [mole/m^3]
    c__B = x[2]  # B [mole/m^3]
    c__C = x[3]  # C [mole/m^3]
    e__A = x[4]  # A [mole/m^3]
    e__B = x[5]  # B [mole/m^3]
    e__C = x[6]  # C [mole/m^3]
    # constants
    e_ = p[1]  # external compartment [m^3]
    c = p[2]  # cell compartment [m^3]
    scale_f = p[4]  # metabolic scaling factor [-]
    Vmax_bA = p[5]  # [mol/s]
    Km_A = p[6]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_bB = p[7]  # [mol/s]
    Km_B = p[8]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_bC = p[9]  # [mol/s]
    Km_C = p[10]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_v1 = p[11]  # [mol/s]
    Keq_v1 = p[12]  # [-]
    Vmax_v2 = p[13]  # [mol/s]
    Vmax_v3 = p[14]  # [mol/s]
    Vmax_v4 = p[15]  # [mol/s]
    Keq_v4 = p[16]  # [-]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    bA = scale_f * (Vmax_bA / Km_A) * (e__A - c__A) / (1.0 + e__A / Km_A + c__A / Km_A)  # bA (A import) [mole/s]
    bB = scale_f * (Vmax_bB / Km_B) * (c__B - e__B) / (1.0 + e__B / Km_B + c__B / Km_B)  # bB (B export) [mole/s]
    bC = scale_f * (Vmax_bC / Km_C) * (c__C - e__C) / (1.0 + e__C / Km_C + c__C / Km_C)  # bC (C export) [mole/s]
    v1 = scale_f * Vmax_v1 / Km_A * (c__A - 1.0 / Keq_v1 * c__B)  # v1 (A -> B) [mole/s]
    v2 = scale_f * Vmax_v2 / Km_A * c__A  # v2 (A -> C) [mole/s]
    v3 = scale_f * Vmax_v3 / Km_A * c__C  # v3 (C -> A) [mole/s]
    v4 = scale_f * Vmax_v4 / Km_A * (c__C - 1.0 / Keq_v4 * c__B)  # v4 (C -> B) [mole/s]
    # rates of change
    dx[1] = (bA - v1 - v2 + v3) / c  # dc__A/dt
    dx[2] = (-bB + v1 + v4) / c  # dc__B/dt
    dx[3] = (-bC + v2 - v3 - v4) / c  # dc__C/dt
    dx[4] = -bA / e_  # de__A/dt
    dx[5] = bB / e_  # de__B/dt
    dx[6] = bC / e_  # de__C/dt
    return nothing
end

"""
    f_y(x, p, t)

The assigned values y at the time t, the rules and the reaction rates.
"""
function f_y(x, p, t)
    # states
    c__A = x[1]  # A [mole/m^3]
    c__B = x[2]  # B [mole/m^3]
    c__C = x[3]  # C [mole/m^3]
    e__A = x[4]  # A [mole/m^3]
    e__B = x[5]  # B [mole/m^3]
    e__C = x[6]  # C [mole/m^3]
    # constants
    scale_f = p[4]  # metabolic scaling factor [-]
    Vmax_bA = p[5]  # [mol/s]
    Km_A = p[6]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_bB = p[7]  # [mol/s]
    Km_B = p[8]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_bC = p[9]  # [mol/s]
    Km_C = p[10]  # [mmol/l]
    Vmax_v1 = p[11]  # [mol/s]
    Keq_v1 = p[12]  # [-]
    Vmax_v2 = p[13]  # [mol/s]
    Vmax_v3 = p[14]  # [mol/s]
    Vmax_v4 = p[15]  # [mol/s]
    Keq_v4 = p[16]  # [-]
    # assigned values and reaction rates
    bA = scale_f * (Vmax_bA / Km_A) * (e__A - c__A) / (1.0 + e__A / Km_A + c__A / Km_A)  # bA (A import) [mole/s]
    bB = scale_f * (Vmax_bB / Km_B) * (c__B - e__B) / (1.0 + e__B / Km_B + c__B / Km_B)  # bB (B export) [mole/s]
    bC = scale_f * (Vmax_bC / Km_C) * (c__C - e__C) / (1.0 + e__C / Km_C + c__C / Km_C)  # bC (C export) [mole/s]
    v1 = scale_f * Vmax_v1 / Km_A * (c__A - 1.0 / Keq_v1 * c__B)  # v1 (A -> B) [mole/s]
    v2 = scale_f * Vmax_v2 / Km_A * c__A  # v2 (A -> C) [mole/s]
    v3 = scale_f * Vmax_v3 / Km_A * c__C  # v3 (C -> A) [mole/s]
    v4 = scale_f * Vmax_v4 / Km_A * (c__C - 1.0 / Keq_v4 * c__B)  # v4 (C -> B) [mole/s]
    return Float64[bA, bB, bC, v1, v2, v3, v4]
end

# the model has no events
const EVENTS = NamedTuple[]

end  # module Koenig_demo_v15
